The '''Fedje system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fedje]], a forested world.<ref name="VF" />
